items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01
items.q: The interviewee does not mention P. Ron. The mention of 'P. Ron' occurs in the [INTERVIEWER]'s turn ('With P. Ron too, didn't he?'), referring to John Marrera's associations. The interviewee does not confirm or deny a personal relationship with P. Ron, nor does he discuss P. Ron directly.

ctx.x: My brother. Which one? John Marrera. You heard talk about John Marrera. He was a leading band you played.
Played with Solishtan a long time. John Marrera. With P. Ron too, didn't he? Yeah. He played with King Joe Oliver. You remember Joe Oliver? Yeah we had the records.

Yeah. And he played with Kid Rene and Buddy Pitty. And he started you on banjo. He started me on banjo. How I started banjo I picked it up to see my mother, she played guitar. My father was a bass player, which you heard about your knowledge. My brother was a bass player and my brother John was a guitar and a banjo player. But they all really was good and I used to listen to them all the time. And my first instrument was a guitar. My first number was Under the Double Eagle. I remember that and I can't play it…
